import React, { useState } from "react"; import { Button, Card, CardHeader, CardBody, FormGroup, Form, Input, Container, Row, Col, Collapse, } from "reactstrap"; import UserHeader from "components/Headers/UserHeader.js"; import { getAuth } from "firebase/auth"; import { getFirestore, doc, setDoc } from "firebase/firestore"; const CarbonFootprintInput = () => { const [collapse, setCollapse] = useState({ transportation: false, energy: false, food: false, waste: false, sustainable: false, offset: false, additionalNotes: false, }); const [userData, setUserData] = useState({ carUsageKm: "", vehicleType: "", fuelType: "", publicTransportTrips: "", publicTransportMode: "", flightsPerYear: "", electricityUsage: "", heatingMethod: "", homeSize: "", energyEfficientAppliances: false, dietType: "", meatFrequency: "", recyclingHabit: false, wasteGeneration: "", renewableEnergyUse: false, ecoFriendlyProducts: false, sustainableShopping: false, carbonOffsetProgram: "", carbonOffsetDetails: "", additionalNotes: "", }); const auth = getAuth(); const db = getFirestore(); const handleChange = (e) => { const { id, value, type, checked } = e.target; setUserData({ ...userData, [id]: type === "checkbox" ? checked : value, }); }; const toggleCollapse = (section) => { setCollapse((prevState) => ({ ...prevState, [section]: !prevState[section], })); }; const handleSubmit = async (e) => { e.preventDefault(); const user = auth.currentUser; if (!user) { console.error("No user is authenticated"); return; } const userFootprintRef = doc(db, `users/${user.uid}-userfootprint`); try { await setDoc(userFootprintRef, userData); console.log("Carbon footprint data submitted successfully!"); } catch (error) { console.error("Error saving data:", error); } }; return ( <>
